_note: Narration for demo/tidy-predict-demo.mp4. 'text' is what is said (for review); 'say' is the spelling given to the voice model. Numbers: out of runs/<id>/out/run.json (17 of 20 in range, 2 above P90, 113 s run) and eval/results (backtest_summary.json, interval_baseline.json).

scenes.text: tidy-predict: a weekly restock note you can sell to small online shops, made on one laptop.
scenes.say: tidy-predict: a weekly restock note you can sell to small online shops, made on one laptop.

scenes.text: The shop sends its order export. Here it's public data: real, anonymised orders from a UK gift shop, replayed as of late November 2011.
scenes.say: The shop sends its order export. Here it's public data: real, anonymised orders from a U.K. gift shop, replayed as of late November, twenty eleven.

scenes.label: Sped up {speed}x. The whole run took 113 s on a laptop CPU.
scenes.text: tidy-predict reads a million rows and sets aside duplicates, returns and postage, with a reason for each. Then TabPFN-2 forecasts next week on the CPU, and Gemma, running locally, writes the note.
scenes.say: tidy-predict reads a million rows, and sets aside duplicates, returns and postage, with a reason for each. Then Tab P F N two forecasts next week on the C P U, and Gemma, running locally, writes the note.

scenes.text: The note says what to have ready for a busy week. Every number in it is checked against the table, so Gemma can't invent one.

Each product gets an expected number and a likely range. It's a replay, so we can check: seventeen of twenty landed in the range. Rabbit night lights did not: the model expected a drop, and the shop sold 4,452.
scenes.say: Each product gets an expected number and a likely range. It's a replay, so we can check: seventeen of twenty landed in the range. Rabbit night lights did not: the model expected a drop, and the shop sold four thousand, four hundred and fifty two.

scenes.text: Every set-aside row is listed with its reason, and the models are credited.

Tested on twelve weeks, run once. With no per-shop factors fitted, TabPFN's ranges came out calibrated: eighty percent inside, and narrower, with fewer units left over, but more units short. On the middle number it's an honest tie with a four-week average whose factors were fitted on earlier months.
scenes.say: Tested on twelve weeks, run once. With no per-shop factors fitted, Tab P F N's ranges came out calibrated: eighty percent inside, and narrower, with fewer units left over, but more units short. On the middle number it's an honest tie with a four-week average whose factors were fitted on earlier months.

scenes.text: Both models are open and local, and TabPFN-2's licence allows paid use. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
scenes.say: Both models are open and local, and Tab P F N two's licence allows paid use. Built with Prior Labs Tab P F N.
